title: Document deferred Cargo target-sibling watcher candidates and their accepted boundary
outcome: The Engram host-adapter feature documentation agrees with the Cargo target-sibling watcher implementation, including deferred terminal judgement and its residual ambiguity.
acceptance: The watcher-fence list and Cargo's build directory paragraph in docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md describe exact root target[A-Za-z0-9]{6} candidates, judging target/ only at carried-gate terminal settlement, path-named refusal without a target directory, and fail-closed overflow at 256 candidates.

The documentation replaces the obsolete claim that the host makes no exception and states that an ordinary exact-shaped root name or descendants of a matching directory can be exempt while target/ exists; persistent non-ignored source remains subject to the settlement source-basis comparison.
